title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) — SPEC.md (Version 0.1 — Draft)
snippet: The authoritative OKF specification: bundle structure, reserved filenames (index.md, log.md), required YAML frontmatter with a REQUIRED `type` field, cross-linking (bundle-relative links), citations, conformance rules, and versioning (okf_version).
quote: The format is intentionally minimal: a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter. There is no schema registry, no central authority, and no required tooling. If you can `cat` a file, you can read OKF; if you can `git clone` a repo, you can ship it.

title: OKF README — GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/okf
snippet: README framing OKF as a universal, vendor-neutral markdown+frontmatter knowledge format; points to SPEC.md as the contribution and to three example bundles (ga4, stackoverflow, crypto_bitcoin).
quote: OKF is a **universal, vendor-neutral format** for representing knowledge as plain markdown files with YAML frontmatter. It is **not tied to any particular agent, framework, model provider, or serving system**.

title: Example OKF concept document — ga4/references/metrics/avg_pageviews.md
snippet: A real conformant concept doc from the ga4 sample bundle: frontmatter with type/resource/title/description/tags/timestamp and a body ending in a `# Citations` heading.
quote:
---
type: Reference
resource: https://developers.google.com/analytics/bigquery/basic-queries
title: Average Pageviews
description: The average number of pageviews per user.
tags:
- metric
timestamp: '2026-05-28T22:51:43+00:00'
---

The average number of pageviews per user.

```sql
SUM(page_view_count) / COUNT(*)
```

# Citations
- https://developers.google.com/analytics/bigquery/basic-queries

title: Example OKF index.md — ga4/index.md (bundle root)
snippet: A real bundle-root index.md. It contains NO frontmatter and does NOT declare okf_version, confirming both are optional and unused in the reference bundles.
quote:
# Subdirectories

* [datasets](datasets/index.md) - A sample of obfuscated Google Analytics BigQuery event export data ...
* [references](references/index.md) - This directory contains specifications for data joins and definitions ...
* [tables](tables/index.md) - Contains Google Analytics event export data from the `ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce` dataset.

title: Absence findings — okf_version usage and log.md files in knowledge-catalog
snippet: Repo-wide code search for `okf_version` returns only the SPEC prose defining it (no bundle actually declares it). A recursive tree scan finds ZERO `log.md` files anywhere. Both features are spec'd-but-unexercised in the reference implementation.
quote: gh search code okf_version --repo GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog => only match: 'okf/SPEC.md: `okf_version: "0.1"` in a bundle-root `index.md`'. Recursive tree filter for '*log.md' => (no results).
